model.description: Kanha Sleep Marionberry Plum Nano Gummy delivers 100mg of indica-powered relaxation in a delicious edible form designed to help you unwind. This fast-acting nano gummy combines the sweet-tart flavor of ripe marionberries with smooth plum notes for a satisfying nighttime treat. Formulated specifically for sleep support, each gummy offers calming, relaxing effects ideal for those seeking relief from restlessness and stress. Kanha's nano technology ensures quicker onset, so you can drift off faster. The indica classification provides the soothing, full-body relaxation you need after a long day. Perfect for evening use, this gummy blends fruity berry and plum flavors with sleepy, calming benefits to support restful nights and deep relaxation.
